lines.text: Via delle Fornaci 7 · Borgo Valdorso (TO) · Production plant
Change: every AF-12 batch is to rest 12 hours in the holding tank
before the QC sample is taken. A viscosity increase above 15 % after 12
h indicates beginning livering: block the batch.
Reason: following DR-1995-031, detect livering caused by alkaline
chromate pigment before the batch is filled.
